expectedResult: The old session cannot access protected data and SAP sign-in is required again without a blank page or raw error.
actualResult: Sign Out showed 'You have signed out of IDTS' and confirmed the application session ended. Reopening the protected application route exposed no Bug/profile data, but rendered a persistent blank white page rather than a SAP sign-in prompt.
reviewBoundary: Session invalidation passed; post-logout protected-route recovery failed. DonHV must review before approved FAIL/Jira disposition.

evidence.description: IDTS signed-out confirmation with SAP BTP sign-in link.
Protected route after logout: no protected data, but blank page instead of sign-in.

privacyReview.notes: Signed-out and blank-route screens contain no email, credential, token, cookie, protected Bug data, or private diagnostic.

issueClassification: product/deployed-auth-flow defect candidate - blank protected route after logout
limitations: The Browser history shortcut did not restore the signed-out page after the blank-route capture; the tab remains signed out and requires a fresh SAP sign-in.
